messages:
quinn: heads-up - nightly linkcheck exploded after the markdown linter update. a bunch of intra-doc anchors are 404ing because encoded vs decoded anchors are mixed (eg `#security%3A` vs `#security`).
lara: can you paste one of the failing log lines?
quinn: linkcheck snippet: 
```
ERROR: 404 https://staging.redwood/docs/security/#security%3A
WARNING - The page 'guides/secure-deploy.md' contains a broken reference to 'security/#security%3A'
```
quinn: the source link is plain `[/docs/security/#security:](/docs/security/#security:)` but our pipeline sometimes percent-encodes `:` in some places and not in others.
tom: i see this when headings include punctuation in translators' edits. docusaurus slugify and our static generator disagree on whether to keep trailing punctuation.
intl-bot: note: translations team often copy headings from legacy docs which included trailing colons and ellipses. recommend a canonicalization rule.
lara: short-term: patch linkcheck to treat decoded and encoded anchors as equivalent. long-term: canonicalize anchors produced during build and generate a redirect map so both forms resolve.
tom: i'll prototype canonicalizer: strip trailing punctuation, normalize unicode punctuation to ascii, lowercase, then percent-encode reserved chars. pseudo:
```
def canonical_anchor(h):
    h = normalize_unicode(h)  # map en-dash, NBSP, etc. to ascii
    h = strip_trailing_punct(h)
    slug = slugify(h)
    return quote(slug, safe='')
```
quinn: that makes sense. also add a small `site/_anchor_redirects.json` with entries mapping legacy variants to the canonical slug so server-level redirects work during rollout.
link-bot: suggested command: `tools/regen-anchors --rewrite --emit-redirects` for repo sweep.
lara: please add unit tests for a few localized cases (fr trailing ellipsis, ja narrow no-break space, de trailing colon). also add a contributor note in CONTRIBUTING.md telling people to run the tool when editing headings.
tom: opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/999 - includes canonicalizer, redirect emitter, unit tests, and a small note in MIGRATION.md. didn't touch translations.
quinn: CI shows linkcheck still failing for one locale: ja. looks like narrow no-break spaces present in some headings. can we add a scan tool to list suspicious unicode characters?
lara: good call. i'll add `tools/scan-invisible-unicode.py` that prints files and line numbers with characters in the U+2000..U+200F range and soft-hyphen.
link-bot: CI: PR 999 failed on docs lint (two files flagged by scan). See https://ci.internal.redwood/anchors/999
tom: fixed the two files in the PR, reran tests. CI green.
quinn: merging now. after merge, please run `tools/regen-anchors --rewrite` in a maintenance window and deploy redirect map.
lara: merged and triggered nightly deploy. linkcheck now passes. created follow-up ticket DOCS-801 to sweep the repo for legacy variants and gradually remove redirects.
quinn: added a short SDK snippet to /docs/guides/sdk-snippets.md showing safe deep-linking:
```
const anchor = encodeURIComponent('Security:');
window.location = `/docs/security/#${anchor}`;
```
quinn: also added a one-line tip in CONTRIBUTING.md: "Avoid invisible unicode when copy/pasting headings; run `tools/scan-invisible-unicode.py` if in doubt."
lara: nice. setting DOCS-801 to low-priority cleanup over next quarter. thanks team. :tada:
